nextGame.note: Sunday home game in the Superdome against Carolina. Noon our time. The Saints and Carolina both have three wins and five losses, so whoever wins this one is alone in first place in their division.

news.headline: Erik McCoy will miss time with his arm injury
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Monday that his center hurt his biceps against Cleveland and will be out for a while, but that he does not think McCoy needs surgery. Will Sherman took over at center on Sunday and is expected to keep the job.

news.headline: Saints beat Cleveland 23-22 in overtime
news.summary: Tyler Shough threw a 15-yard touchdown to Juwan Johnson in overtime, and the Saints held on when Cleveland scored at the very end but missed its two-point try. It is the Saints' first home win of the season, and they are now three wins and five losses.

news.headline: Saints are tied for first in their division
news.summary: The Saints and Carolina both have three wins and five losses, the best records in the NFC South. The two teams play each other in the Superdome on Sunday.

nextGame.note: Saturday evening road game in Lexington, Kentucky. A quarter past five our time. Florida has won five games and lost four and needs one more win to reach a bowl game. Kentucky has won seven games and lost two.

news.headline: Florida has not picked a quarterback for Kentucky
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that both of his quarterbacks practiced and that one of them will start Saturday, but he did not say which one. He also said Jeramiah McCloud, who was suspended for the Oklahoma game, is back and should play.

news.headline: Florida's game at Kentucky is set for Saturday evening
news.summary: Kickoff in Lexington is a quarter past five our time. The game is on ESPN.

news.headline: Oklahoma beats Florida 23-7 in Gainesville
news.summary: Florida scored one touchdown, in the second quarter, and did not score again. The Gators have lost four of their last five games and are five wins and four losses.

nextGame.note: Saturday night home game in Baton Rouge. Half past six our time. LSU has won six games and lost three. Texas has won seven and lost two.

news.headline: Alabama beats LSU 31-13 in Tiger Stadium
news.summary: Sam Leavitt threw for 380 yards, but LSU missed on all four of its fourth-down tries and scored only 13 points. The Tigers are now six wins and three losses.

news.headline: Whit Weeks is now expected to miss the Alabama game
news.summary: A CBS Sports reporter said Thursday that LSU does not expect its best linebacker to play Saturday. He broke a bone in his leg in late September, and the team had hoped he would be ready for this one.

news.headline: Princewill Umanmielen is up for a national award
news.summary: LSU's defensive end is one of 12 players still in the running for the Lombardi Award, which goes to the best lineman or linebacker in the country. Four finalists are named November 18 and the winner on December 9.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Houston. One o'clock our time. Tulane has won four games and lost five. Rice has won one game and lost eight. Tulane needs to win two of its last three games to reach a bowl game.

news.headline: Tulane's coach takes the blame for the 60-10 loss
news.summary: Will Hall said the loss to Tulsa starts with him and that Tulane did not do anything well. He also said punter William Hudlow hurt a finger in the game and that he hopes to have him back this week.

news.headline: Tulsa routs Tulane 60-10 at Homecoming
news.summary: Tulsa led 32-0 at halftime and Tulane never got going, losing by 50 points in front of the Homecoming crowd at Yulman Stadium. It is the worst conference loss Tulane has ever had, and the Green Wave are now four wins and five losses.

news.headline: Tulane's athletic director calls the loss unacceptable
news.summary: David Harris, who runs sports at Tulane, put out a statement Saturday night saying he was embarrassed and that losing by 50 points was unacceptable. He did not announce any changes to the coaching staff.

nextGame.label: Playoff second round, against the winner of Bonnabel and Peabody
nextGame.note: Brother Martin is the 8th seed and does not play this week — it has a bye in the first round. Its next game is the second round, played November 19, 20 or 21, against the winner of Bonnabel and Peabody. Bonnabel hosts Peabody on Friday night. Bonnabel is the team that beat Warren Easton 29-28 last Thursday.

news.headline: Brother Martin gets the 8th seed and a first-round bye
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Brother Martin does not have to play in the first round and will wait for the winner of Bonnabel and Peabody.

news.headline: Easton Royal scores four touchdowns in Brother Martin win
news.summary: Royal ran for 165 yards and three touchdowns and returned a kickoff 75 yards for another in the 27-14 win over Holy Cross. Brother Martin finished the regular season with seven wins and three losses.

news.headline: Brother Martin beats Chalmette 27-21
news.summary: Brother Martin won a district game Friday night in Chalmette. The Crusaders are 6-3 and finish the regular season on the road against Holy Cross next Friday.
